items.title: Aptar Pharma to support Aceso’s inhaled cystic fibrosis candidate’s advance

items.title: EU pharma industry pushes for expansion of barcodes on medicines
items.summary: The EAHP and EFPIA want all individual doses to carry a barcode, an addition they say will further reduce medication errors.

items.title: AtomVie opens $160m radiopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Ontario
items.summary: AtomVie has opened a purpose-built radiopharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, with an investment of over $160m.
